lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters are visible, with the most distinct nodes concentrated in the mid-flank region posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated intensity are present, forming an approximate grid pattern where they cross the horizontal rows of blobs, most visible in the anterior half of the exposed flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral surface, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal-facing slope.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse collection of small high-luminance spots is visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located along the mid-to-lower section of the fin's surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, dark, elongated shapes consistent with commensal fish (remoras) are visible beneath the ventral line and near the pectoral fin.
